description: CodeRex is a team of aspiring developers passionate about technology, data science, and space exploration. We aim to use NASA's open data to discover Earth system trends and turn scientific insights into simple, meaningful visualizations. Through innovation, programming, and teamwork, we hope to make Earth science easier to understand.
summary:
**EarthScope — Earth Trend Explorer**

EarthScope is an interactive climate data analysis platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 by Team CodeRex.

The platform uses NASA POWER datasets to analyze environmental parameters such as temperature, rainfall and relative humidity. Focusing on Nashik, Maharashtra, from 2015 to 2025, EarthScope transforms historical climate data into meaningful visualizations, trend analysis, anomaly detection and climate insights.

With an interactive Earth globe, analytics dashboard, data explorer and downloadable reports, EarthScope aims to make complex environmental data accessible and understandable to everyone.

**Our mission:** Transform NASA Earth observation data into meaningful insights that help people understand our changing planet.
details:
EarthScope — Earth System Trend Explorer

EarthScope is an interactive, full-stack Earth science platform developed by Team CodeRex for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The project addresses the challenge of understanding complex environmental changes by transforming authentic NASA environmental observations into meaningful visual insights.

Using NASA POWER API v2, EarthScope retrieves environmental data and applies scientific statistical methods, including Ordinary Least Squares regression, Mann-Kendall trend testing, Sen's slope estimation and Z-score-based anomaly detection.

The platform features an interactive 3D Earth globe, climate analytics dashboard, temperature and rainfall analysis, geographical comparisons, statistical analysis, anomaly detection and downloadable scientific reports.

Built using Python, FastAPI, Three.js, WebGL, Chart.js and Leaflet, EarthScope combines scientific data processing with modern interactive visualization.

Our mission is to make Earth observation data more accessible and empower people to investigate, understand and interpret changes in Earth's environmental systems.

Team: CodeRex
Challenge: Be An Earth System Trend Detective!
